# Hedera Merchant Payments

Non-custodial merchant invoices on Hedera. Customer funds move payer → merchant in the same transaction. The registry never holds a balance.

Scaffold: `npx create-scaffold-hbar@latest merchant-payments --template adamfreeman2024-eng/hedera-merchant-payments -s hardhat -f nextjs-app --yes`

## Read paths (no keys)

- `GET /api/health` — readiness + custody statement
- `GET /api/quote?tokenIn=0.0.x&tokenOut=0.0.x&amountOut=<base>` — live SaucerSwap V1 quote; `ok:false` if no pool
- `GET /api/receipts?topic=0.0.x&id=INV-…` — rebuild from HCS via Mirror Node (no database)
- `GET /api/agent/manifest` — machine card for coding agents
- `/receipt?topic=0.0.x&id=INV-…` or `/receipt/INV-…`

## Custody

Not escrow. Not withdraw-from-contract. Atomic HTS / SaucerSwap settlement pays the merchant encoded on the invoice. Leftover tokenIn returns to the payer in the same transaction.

## Do not confuse with

- Official `payments-scheduler` (cron, not invoices)
- Official `x402-pay-per-use` (pay-per-request API)
- Escrow-and-withdraw invoice templates: those hold funds in a contract until the merchant withdraws. This template does not.
